source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; broadly filters DIMM, TEMP_DIMM or PCH temperature using credential-bearing OOB command and calls the result CPU/DIMM data.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at MEDIUM risk; populated DIMM topology, exact slot/sensor mapping, per-slot range/status/freshness policy, complete protected output and same-target comparison.

historical_reviews.deepseek: The broad filter can substitute PCH or CPU temperature for DIMM data and does not prove coverage of every populated slot.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly requires the actual memory population and slot-to-sensor map, distinguishing unpopulated slots from missing telemetry.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DIMM temperature coverage is topology-dependent. A missing record is expected for some unpopulated slots but a defect for populated modules with required sensors; evaluation therefore needs the as-built channel/slot inventory and must never infer completeness from a count or a generic label.

original_test_intent: Read BMC/IPMI temperature telemetry for every populated DIMM and verify correct slot identity, value, unit, health status and freshness against the approved memory topology and thermal policy.
original_method: Capture the exact as-built DIMM population, enumerate complete protected sensor/SDR data before filtering, map records to CPU/channel/slot, apply vendor range/status/freshness and unpopulated-slot rules, cross-check the same target and preserve diagnostic state.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies the as-built DIMM population and exact slot/sensor semantics; an operator verifies the target and reviews missing, unpopulated or cross-source exceptions.
required_inputs: Expected units, range, status and thresholds
safety_requirements: Do not treat PCH or CPU sensors as DIMMs
Distinguish unpopulated from missing populated slots
Stop on stale, duplicate, malformed or unmapped data
Never alter memory, fan or thresholds to force agreement
agent_execution_scope: Map each DIMM sensor to physical slot
Compare all populated slots with approved rules and same-target source
Record topology exceptions and no-mutation audit

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The broad `DIMM|TEMP_DIMM|PCH.*Temp` filter violates sensor identity by admitting PCH data and uses an OOB credential-bearing path; it cannot prove per-populated-slot completeness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete protected in-band IPMI sensor/SDR output and, only after owner-approved mapping, select exact DIMM sensor IDs and compare per-slot value/unit/status/freshness with the populated topology and same-target source.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 5/5-minute read-only in-band monitoring intent remains; the incomplete `Check` is made topology-specific and logs remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a CPU/channel/slot matrix containing population state, DIMM identity, sensor ID/entity, raw/normalized temperature, unit, status, threshold, freshness and comparison result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces broad name filtering with exact physical slot provenance and explicit handling of unpopulated or sensorless modules.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A collection of plausible temperatures can omit a populated DIMM or include unrelated PCH/CPU values while still looking complete.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some platforms aggregate temperatures by channel or lack per-DIMM sensors; the vendor topology contract must state the accepted coverage level.

project_override_considerations: The Project must publish the platform's DIMM telemetry granularity and physical slot mapping. If only channel aggregation exists, it must be explicitly accepted rather than mislabeled as every-DIMM coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact target and as-built memory topology
Approved sensor/entity-to-slot map and thermal rules

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request DIMM temperature monitoring. The incomplete Check and missing topology are owner-input gaps, while DeepSeek's PCH substitution is a reference overreach rather than a Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Memory topology and a vendor sensor map can normally resolve coverage. Execution blocks only if populated-slot identity or protected read evidence cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents unrelated PCH/CPU temperatures or unpopulated-slot assumptions from hiding a missing or invalid populated-DIMM sensor.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC SDR labels may abbreviate channels and slots differently from SMBIOS or physical silkscreen, and not all modules expose individual temperature. Correlating the as-built topology with entity/locator data is necessary before determining whether a missing sensor is expected; freshness also matters because a removed or failed module can leave a stale plausible value.
